title: Hardship Settlement Extension Allowance for an Extended Hardship Hold
content:
# Hardship Settlement — Hold-Extension Allowance

How often the consumer's qualifying hold under Ridgeline's Hardship and Protective Holds has been extended, as the hold record's extension count shows, bears on a due-date extension of an accepted Hardship Settlement under its Settlement Agreements.

**Rule.** Where the consumer's qualifying hardship hold on the account was extended two or more times, the Hardship Settlement hold-extension allowance of 4 days is added; where it was extended exactly once, the hold-extension allowance is 2 days; a hold that was never extended earns no hold-extension allowance.

| Extensions of the qualifying hold | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 4 days |
| exactly 1 | 2 days |
| none | none |

## Basis Q&A

**Q. The hold was extended three times. Is the allowance 6 days?** No; two or more extensions earn 4 days.

**Q. Does an extension of the settlement itself count here?** No; the rule reads the extensions of the hardship hold.
